select id,user_name,name,plate_num,car_color,tel_num,balance,status,user_pic,vip_start_time,vip_end_time,create_time,update_time from user
plate_num like concat('%',#{plateNum},'%')
and car_color like concat('%',#{carColor},'%')
and status=#{status}
and user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
order by create_time desc,id desc
